children.name: To see the effect of different launcher options, try launching different URI schemes.
Launch the URI with the default handler installed on the system.
If supported, let the user choose the handler for the URI.
If supported, warn the user before launching.
If supported, launch the URI with a preference for how much of the screen to leave for this app.
The result depends on a number of things, including the preferences of the app being launched. Pick URI schemes of various types to see the behavior when launching different apps.
